!!! note "Why this matters more than it looks"
    Printed airframes routinely finish 20–30 % over estimate, and on a two-motor VTOL that
    overrun compounds: more mass needs more thrust, which needs a heavier motor, which adds mass.
    Catching it part by part is the difference between adjusting the battery and rebuilding the
    airframe.
